customManagers.description: CLI tool versions in workflow env blocks and in .github/scripts shell defaults (VAR="${VAR:-version}"), each annotated with a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=... [extractVersion=...]' comment on the line above.

packageRules.description: sops is pinned with a sha256 next to its version in .github/scripts/install-sops.sh; the ci Ansible job fails until the hash is updated, so a reviewer must copy the new linux.amd64 hash from the release's checksums file.
GitHub Actions, Go modules, and Dockerfile base images: auto-merge patch and minor updates (and digest pins/refreshes) when CI passes.
Our own pttd image in compose.yaml: its digest is updated only by the deploy pipeline.
Android and Gradle dependencies: one grouped PR per month, merged by a person after a quick check.
OpenTofu/Terraform: kept current, merged by a person.
OpenTofu providers and modules: look them up in the OpenTofu registry.
required_version tracks OpenTofu releases, not Terraform.
Go toolchain minor bumps (go directive, toolchain, golang base image) are reviewed by a person.
Major versions are never auto-merged. Keep this rule last so it wins.
